notes: Every town and city is now built from the same bright modular buildings (no more dark medieval pieces).
Cars are in every town: they explode when you hit them, and they drive away from where you are headed.
People walk the streets, run away as you fly close, and are killed when you reach them.
Move the launcher anywhere in the city (MOVE button / map) and aim a full 180 degrees sideways and up/down.
Whole buildings break into pieces instead of flying off as one cube, and loose debris falls instead of hanging in the air.
Thinner, more detailed comic-ink look (INK button), with brighter dark surfaces.
Windows PC version (separate download): keyboard, mouse and any controller, every control remappable, and a graphics screen that detects your screen and GPU.
